hints.title: Character Set Equivalence
hints.text: Two words are similar if and only if they contain the identical set of distinct characters.

hints.title: Bitmask Representation of Distinct Characters
hints.text: Since words consist solely of lowercase English letters, a 26-bit integer mask uniquely identifies the character set.

hints.title: Mask Frequency Combination
hints.text: Count the occurrence of each bitmask. For each mask seen c times, add c * (c - 1) // 2 pairs.

hints.title: Character Bitmask Pair Counting Implementation

variables: L: maximum length of a word
complexity.notes: Converting each word to a 26-bit mask followed by hash map accumulation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of words with set comparisons takes O(N^2 * L).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory to store mask counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Represents character sets as bitmasks to enable linear time frequency aggregation.
